'''Clemont''' is a male NPC found by the lighthouse in Port of Riccioli, [[Riccioli Islands]]. He is a colleague of [[Bertoli]]. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Clemont''': You're telling me... this lighthouse existed even before the founding of Ragunna?
:'''Paxton''': Huh? What was that?
:'''Clemont''': I said... this very lighthouse, it was here before Ragunna was even a thought, right?
:'''Paxton''': Ah, yes, that's right.
:'''Paxton''': They say [[Imperator]] built these lighthouses as part of some grand plan, something They laid out long before.
:'''Paxton''': The tale has been passed down through the ages. My great-grandfather spoke of it, too.
:{{DIcon}} That would make it older than the [[Order of the Deep]].
:'''Clemont''': Well, if it's really true, it would make this place an archaeological treasure trove.
:'''Paxton''': Stove? You looking to roast some fish? Head to the market, you'll find it there, easy enough.
:'''Clemont''': Ah, it  seems your hearing is a bit...
:'''Clemont''': It's quite alright, old sir! Thank you! Have a nice day!
:'''Paxton''': Aye, sure, you're welcome, kid. If you're serious about diggin' up stories, head on over to Helm Village. Those old codgers are no younger than me. They'll have stories to share.
{{Dialogue End}}
